trade.title: Press in the setup zone
trade.mentor: Gabo: Support tested 3x. Funding rate negative. Volume growing. Green zone is the ideal.
trade.perfectLesson: Hit the exact setup. Consolidation plus negative funding means the market is positioned wrong. That's the edge.
trade.okLesson: Close. Slightly early or late. In practice, more slippage and a tighter stop.
trade.missLesson: Outside the setup zone. FOMO, not analysis. Gabo: wait for confirmation, always.

steps.title: Welcome, Stander
steps.body: Name your character. Your run is saved locally on this device — no account needed.

steps.title: How you earn EP
steps.body: Engage Points are a conceptual learning score. You earn them by doing well: the best dialogue choices, and quizzes or mini-games graded by stars (30 / 50 / 80 EP). Weak or skipped actions earn nothing.

steps.title: Your goal: SEED
steps.body: Climb the Growth Path. SEED is the real goal — 3,000 EP plus real Discord activity. Act I is your on-ramp: you finish it as a Seed Candidate, ready to keep growing.

steps.title: Squads
steps.body: Finish the Seed Hall (Chapter 6) to choose your Squad: Content, Creative, Outreach, Tech or Offline. Open the Squads tab any time to preview them.

steps.title: Ready
steps.body: Six chapters take you from New Stander to Seed. Start Chapter 1 and meet Mira.

roadmap.title: From 0 to FLOWER
roadmap.intro: This is how the Growth Path works inside the real StandX Discord. The game trains you for it — EP here is practice; the real score lives in Discord.

steps.title: Join Discord & claim the Events role
steps.body: First move after joining: claim the Events role so every new event pings you. Without it, you miss opportunities.

steps.title: Accumulate Engage Points
steps.body: Events, social campaigns, content creation, daily activity and real community participation all add up.

steps.title: Hit 3,000 EP and apply for SEED
steps.body: Not automatic — the team manually reviews your account to verify you're a real contributor, not a bot. Rejected? You can reapply in 2 weeks.

steps.title: Choose your squad
steps.body: Creative, Offline, Tech, Outreach or Content. Pick what you're actually skilled at — not what looks easiest.

steps.title: Complete squad missions → SPROUT
steps.body: Maintain 4,000+ EP, hit your squad's milestones, stay consistently active and earn moderator approval. Every contribution is tracked on a Notion board.

steps.title: FLOWER — prove leadership
steps.body: There is no public checklist. SEED proves activity, SPROUT proves contribution, FLOWER proves leadership. Very few will reach it.

roadmap.flowerNote: No FLOWER has been selected yet. The seat is open — that scarcity is exactly what makes it valuable.
